claim(uint256).notice: Claim bought tokens after a successful sale.

contribute(uint256,uint256).notice: Contribute stablecoin during the sale window.

createLaunch(address,uint256,uint256,uin.notice: Create a sale. The seller must approve `tokensForSale` to this contract first; the tokens are pulled in at creation so a sale can never promise tokens it does not hold.

finalize(uint256).notice: Finalize after endTime. Anyone can call. Sets Success when the soft cap was met, Failed otherwise, and earmarks the liquidity reserve on success.

progress(uint256).notice: Progress: raised, caps, percent (bps), contributors, tokens sold.

refund(uint256).notice: Refund in full after a failed sale.

releaseLiquidity(uint256).notice: Release earmarked liquidity reserves to the set manager. Reverts until a liquidity manager is set (DEX route confirmed).

setLiquidityManager(address).notice: Set the liquidity-manager contract that may receive the earmarked liquidity reserves. Only the owner, only to a non-zero address, and only after the DEX route for launch liquidity is confirmed. Until set, reserves stay locked (pending, not lost).

tokensOwed(uint256,address).notice: Tokens owed to a contributor at the sale price.

withdrawRaised(uint256).notice: Seller withdraws raised funds minus the liquidity reserve, after a successful sale. Unsold deposited tokens stay in the contract with the liquidity reserve (they are part of it).

withdrawUnsoldTokens(uint256).notice: Leftover deposited tokens (unsold, not earmarked) return to the seller after a successful sale once liquidity is released, or after a failed sale. Keeps seller funds from stranding.

@title StelixLaunchpad — free fixed-price token sale on Arc testnet
 @notice Gas only, NO Stelix launch fee. A seller creates a sale for an
 existing ERC-20 (e.g. one made by StelixTokenFactory) at a fixed price
 in the exit stablecoin (USDC on Arc testnet,
 0x3600000000000000000000000000000000000000, 6 decimals).
 Price: `pricePerToken` = stablecoin smallest units per ONE WHOLE token.
 Example: token with 18 decimals at $0.10 -> pricePerToken = 100_000
 (0.10 USDC = 100,000 micro-USDC). A 10 USDC contribution buys
 10_000_000 * 10^18 / 100_000 = 100 tokens.
 Flow: createLaunch (seller deposits the tokens for sale up front) ->
 contribute during [startTime, endTime] -> finalize after endTime ->
   - raised >= softCap (SUCCESS): contributors claim tokens, the
     seller withdraws raised funds minus the liquidity reserve.
   - raised < softCap (FAILED): contributors refund in full.
 Liquidity lock: `liquidityLockBps` (max 50%) of the raised funds plus
 the matching tokens at the sale price are earmarked in the contract at
 finalize. They can ONLY be released to a liquidity-manager contract
 set by the owner (setLiquidityManager) — until a DEX route for launch
 liquidity is confirmed and that manager is set and audited, the
 reserves stay locked in this contract. The step is therefore
 'pending Arc DEX confirmation', never silently skipped and never
 paid out to the seller. See README section "Launchpad liquidity".
 Safety: reentrancy-guarded fund-moving functions, checks-effects-
 interactions, no fee, no admin withdrawal of user funds (the seller
 can only withdraw THEIR OWN raised funds after a successful sale;
 contributors can only claim/refund their own amounts).
